parent.disposition: FIT nullspace makes correct unseen functions nonidentifiable on some inputs even with known correct role binding and expressive model

science_question: Can equal-budget informative causal interventions resolve a proven FIT nullspace and improve heldout generalization without revealing source law, rather than growing models or retuning consumed cases?
class: 256 pair inputs consisting of 4-bit source-current/target-current, 163 degree<=4 Boolean monomials over 8 raw bits; same privileged public hypothesis space to every learner; no unknown-class claim

active_design.oracle_scope: SOURCEFREE 4-bit target-current and source-current pair only; every new query obtains one 4-bit counterfactual response not in original FIT; candidate and all competitors have exactly same total per-budget query opportunities; no query may use CHECK/HELDOUT labels
active_design.meta_train: 8 distinct pre-frozen synthetic meta task seeds 900-907, only public features, per-pair frequency learned over full synthetic episodes; both candidate and strongest peer receive identical learned frequency score; no target source law/hidden seed
active_design.candidate: rank-independent active intervention choice prioritized by pre-trained public meta frequency, equal equation solver
active_design.strong_peer: independently implemented full-rank greedy matching SAME meta-frequency ranking and full oracle budget; not an underinformed random comparator
active_design.secondary_control: independent pure lexicographic maximum-information/rank greedy, same full query budget

metrics.natural_CHECK_admission: all 8/8 heldout-like positive CHECK trajectories exact without teacher forcing
metrics.whole_OS: one fresh Linux wait4 full Python/import/training/oracle query/CHECK/heldout process per arm/family/seed/query-budget; CPU and max RSS, resource_nonregression_not_inferred

ablation: If no-query FIT rank is deficient, explicit nullspace witness proves no learning algorithm can uniquely determine every unseen mapping without additional information or inductive restriction; oracle queries add actual information and must never be credited as learning from original FIT alone
